Subject: Board narrative edit sprint — slide owners, data asks, and decision log

Team —

Kickoff for the investor/board readout: we've got a compressed window to land the narrative and a clean deck for the Aug 12 board packaging. Please find attached the master deck and the initial metrics table. Quick plan below: 

- Owners: I've assigned the slide groups in the first column of the deck (visible in slide notes). If you prefer a different owner, reply with a swap before EOD Aug 1.
- Data asks: aditya -> growth & ARR slide; marcus -> revenue cadence + partner backlog; neha -> risk & governance slide (legal clearance needed).
- Decision log: start capturing any major decisions or framing choices in decision_log.md (attached). We'll keep a short audit for the board packet.
- Timeline: edits in the shared deck by EOD Aug 2; consolidated redline for exec review by Aug 3; final signoff and export by Aug 4 evening so we have time for formatting and drive links.

Please flag anything that cannot be met in that timeline. If you have data dependencies that require product or finance pulls, call that out inline with the specific field.

Attachments: INVESTOR_SLIDE_MASTER_v2.pptx (master, comments enabled), Q3_metrics_table.csv (raw), decision_log.md

Thanks —
Maya Srinivasan
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

I've pushed a redline to the shared deck and created a copy with comments: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_boarddeck (Updated: Neha-redline). Key calls and asks: 

1) Governance slide: Legal needs one business day to review language tied to the "data residency" paragraph. Please avoid technical promises — instead, high-level control statements.
2) Runway language: finance asked to avoid projecting ARR-based runway; we should show burn vs committed ARR and call out sensitivity scenarios.
3) Decision log entry (attached): I logged the alternate titles for the "platform roadmap" slide and a note recommending the product callout be framed as "operational reliability improvements" rather than feature-signal.
